evidence: Pinned E11F..E134 separates mode zero from the nonzero family and tests the later live selected vehicle. Negative selection performs only the existing Popup/Scroll/FlatButton cleanup and shared exit; nonnegative out-of-table modes join E216 reset instead of continuing normal click processing. Exact ten-cell table decoding confirms the existing action switch is already correct; its linear block order is not selector order.
payload.hypothesis: MapWin cursor processing must exit for every nonzero captured mode; the original negative live selection exits without the order-state reset.
